faq.q: Which words stay lower case in Title Case?
faq.a: Short joining words such as a, an, the, and, but, or, of, in, on, to and for, unless they start the title, end it or follow a colon. Acronyms like NASA and names like iPhone are kept as you typed them.

faq.q: I typed with Caps Lock on. Can I fix it?
faq.a: Yes. Choose Sentence case: it lowers everything and capitalizes the start of each sentence and the word “I”. When most of the text is in capitals, it’s treated as shouting rather than as acronyms.

faq.q: What is camelCase, snake_case and kebab-case?
faq.a: Ways of writing several words without spaces, used in programming and file names: camelCase joins words with capitals (firstName), snake_case uses underscores (first_name) and kebab-case uses hyphens (first-name).
